cards.headline: LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data

source.excerpt: Together, our findings highlight that while contextual flexibility is persistently difficult for models, how category knowledge is expressed in pretraining greatly impacts models' acquisition of robust category knowledge.

cards.headline: Global research trends in embryonic mosaicism and mosaic embryo transfer

source.title: Global research trends in embryonic mosaicism and mosaic embryo transfer: a bibliometric and science-mapping analysis.
source.excerpt: This bibliometric analysis of 394 publications spanning 36 years demonstrates sustained, accelerating growth in research output since 2015, driven by the clinical adoption of NGS-based PGT-A and the subsequent dissemination of major professional society guidelines.

cards.headline: Ihr da seid es doch, die ihr über etwas gestritten habt, wovon ihr Wissen habt …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:66
source.excerpt: ها أنتم يا هؤلاء جادلتم رسول الله محمدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فيما لكم به علم مِن أمر دينكم، مما تعتقدون صحته في كتبكم، فلِمَ تجادلون فيما ليس لكم به علم من أمر إبراهيم؟ والله يعلم الأمور على خفائها، وأنتم لا تعلمون.

cards.arabic: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
cards.translation: Ihr da seid es doch, die ihr über etwas gestritten habt, wovon ihr Wissen habt; warum streitet ihr nun aber über etwas, wovon ihr kein Wissen habt? Allah weiß, ihr aber wißt nicht.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Disputing with the Jews and Christians About the Religion of Ibrahim: Allah censures the Jews and Christians for their dispute with Muslims over Ibrahim Al-Khalil and the claim each group made that he was one of them.

cards.headline: Ibrahim war weder ein Jude noch ein Christ, sondern er war Anhänger des rechten Glaubens …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:67
source.excerpt: ما كان إبراهيم يهودياً ولا نصرانياً، فلم تكن اليهودية ولا النصرانية إلا من بعده، ولكن كان متبعًا لأمر الله وطاعته، مستسلمًا لربه، وما كان من المشركين.

cards.arabic: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
cards.translation: Ibrahim war weder ein Jude noch ein Christ, sondern er war Anhänger des rechten Glaubens, einer, der sich Allah ergeben hat, und er gehörte nicht zu den Götzendienern.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Disputing with the Jews and Christians About the Religion of Ibrahim: Allah censures the Jews and Christians for their dispute with Muslims over Ibrahim Al-Khalil and the claim each group made that he was one of them.

cards.headline: Multi-Omics Biomarkers From Variant to Clinic

source.title: Multi-Omics Biomarkers From Variant to Clinic: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Evidence, AI/ML, Governance, Equity, and Real-World Implementation Across Global Health Systems.
source.excerpt: Multi-omics biomarkers offer substantial analytical advantages, but their translation requires standardized validation frameworks, accountable AI governance, interoperable infrastructure, and globally inclusive data sets to ensure equitable, trustworthy implementation.

source.title: Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
source.excerpt: These findings establish the groundwork for smart home agents as grid operators to increase overall resilience on the grid edge.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in pain assessment and management for older adults

source.title: Artificial intelligence in pain assessment and management for older adults: A scoping review.
source.excerpt: AI applications for pain management in older adults are growing rapidly, with machine learning dominating prediction and classification tasks. Despite technical progress, most tools remain early-stage, rely on limited datasets, and lack aging-specific dynamics.

cards.headline: Tobacco smoking history and antibiotic-resistant infection

source.title: Tobacco smoking history and antibiotic-resistant infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Tobacco smoking history is associated with increased odds of antibiotic-resistant infection, with the evidence predominantly derived from studies of drug-resistant tuberculosis. Smoking cessation and tobacco-control interventions may be relevant to antimicrobial-resistance containment efforts, particularly in tuberculosis programs.

source.excerpt: Institutionalised external validation, reproducibility through open code and data, declaration of dataset overlap and conflicts of interest, and clinically meaningful outcomes are the priorities for future work.

cards.headline: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control

source.title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
source.excerpt: Overall, the proposed framework enables the generation of realistic multi-view echocardiographic sequences from diverse cardiac models, providing a scalable source of annotated data for dataset augmentation and the development of multi-view cardiac assessment methods.

cards.headline: Comparison of the readability of ChatGPT and Bard in medical communication

source.title: Comparison of the readability of ChatGPT and Bard in medical communication: a meta-analysis.
source.publisher: BMC medical informatics and decision making
source.excerpt: Readability of spontaneously generated texts by Bard/Gemini was slightly superior compared to ChatGPT-3.5/-4.0 and readability of simplified texts by ChatGPT-3.5/-4.0 tended to be improved compared to Bard. Results are limited due study quality and publication bias. Standardized reporting could improve study quality and chatbot development.

cards.headline: Development of AI competencies within the medical curriculum

source.title: Development of AI competencies within the medical curriculum.
source.excerpt: AI competencies should be recognized as a core component of the medical curriculum. Integrated, longitudinal, and active learning-based educational models provide the strongest foundation for preparing future physicians to critically evaluate, ethically govern, and effectively collaborate with AI technologies in clinical practice.

source.title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
source.excerpt: We review evidence that some VLAs with near-perfect benchmark scores fail when objects or the camera move slightly, and open up further research questions.

cards.headline: AI literacy and competency in nursing education

source.title: AI literacy and competency in nursing education: preparing students and faculty members for an AI-enabled future-a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Thematic synthesis underscores the need for standardized AI education, tailored faculty development, and equitable access to digital tools. Although individual-level awareness and attitudes toward AI are promising, this review reveals a lack of institutional readiness, with many nursing programs lacking standardized curricula, faculty training, and infrastructural support.

cards.headline: Die Menschen, die Ibrahim am nächsten stehen, sind wahrlich diejenigen, die ihm folgten …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:68
source.excerpt: إنَّ أحق الناس بإبراهيم وأخصهم به، الذين آمنوا به وصدقوا برسالته واتبعوه على دينه، وهذا النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم والذين آمنوا به. والله وليُّ المؤمنين به المتبعين شرعه.

cards.arabic: إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَـٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
cards.translation: Die Menschen, die Ibrahim am nächsten stehen, sind wahrlich diejenigen, die ihm folgten, sowie dieser Prophet und die, die (mit ihm) glauben. Und Allah ist der Schutzherr der Gläubigen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Disputing with the Jews and Christians About the Religion of Ibrahim: Allah censures the Jews and Christians for their dispute with Muslims over Ibrahim Al-Khalil and the claim each group made that he was one of them.

cards.headline: Gern möchte euch ein Teil von den Leuten der Schrift in die Irre führen.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:69
source.excerpt: تمنَّت جماعة من اليهود والنصارى لو يضلونكم -أيها المسلمون- عن الإسلام، وما يضلون إلا أنفسهم وأتباعهم، وما يدرون ذلك ولا يعلمونه.

cards.arabic: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
cards.translation: Gern möchte euch ein Teil von den Leuten der Schrift in die Irre führen. Aber sie führen nur sich selbst in die Irre, ohne (es) zu merken.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Envy the Jews Feel Towards Muslims; Their Wicked Plots Against Muslims: Allah states that the Jews envy the faithful and wish they could misguide them. Allah states that the punishment of this behavior will fall back upon them, while they are unaware.
